title: Jared's Place - 2BR/2.5 bath Condo in Nashville!
description:
Enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located condo near all Nashville attractions. 

Our son moved here in 2018 to pursue a music career. He filled his home with love & music. When we lost our precious Jared in the Spring of 2021, we couldn't bear to say goodbye to his home and all the personally chosen things inside that still characterize it as Jared's Place. Jared's warm, joyful spirit and so many happy memories still reside here. We hope you make your own happy memories here.

The space
Downstairs:  Spacious living room with vaulted ceiling; large fully furnished kitchen & dining space; half bath; master bedroom with king bed & adjoining, private full bathroom with walk-in closet.
Upstairs:  Loft with workspace desk & queen sleeper sofa; second bedroom with queen bed & adjoining private full bathroom.
Outdoors:  Patio with privacy fence, dining tables, & string lights for nighttime enjoyment.

Guest access
You will have the entire condo to yourselves.

Other things to note
OUTDOOR surveillance cameras protect the property.  No cameras are located inside the home.
